name: counterexample-studio
description: Turn plain-English data invariants into minimized, runnable counterexamples and regression tests.

interface.shortDescription: Find the smallest proof of silent wrong data.
interface.longDescription: Counterexample Studio helps Codex compile data-behavior invariants into deterministic differential tests, minimize silent semantic failures, and export runnable regression tests with a verifiable evidence bundle.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Counterexample Studio to turn this data-behavior expectation into an executable contract, run the differential lab, and return the smallest reproducible counterexample.
